description: Andrew-direct 2026-08-24 ~13:2xZ at the base CTO terminal, the Monday push order D2 note, VERBATIM: 'We are going to need to come up with a more robust solution for where this data comes from. What it seems like we effectively may have to do is some blend of the 0824 and 0833 schwab accounts, relevant black diamond metatables, and eventually maybe fidelity. the issue is that 0833 has very little lookback. Black Diamond itself is the master for all assets but i get nervous about them so would rather focus on schwab and not rely on a third party solution and just flesh out our hisotircal data blending the schwab accounts versus putting dependency back on BD. WE need to think about how to manage this considering.' Disposition (record ANDREW_DIRECT_20260824_MONDAY_PUSH_ORDER_BY_DIRECTIVE.md): CTO drafts the 49F data-sourcing PRD (purpose-level, pipeline stage 1+2) around that constraint set; the earlier 'history reconciliation program' framing is SUPERSEDED (BD-gold-port is no longer the default remedy -- the Schwab blend is); the 0824/0833 distinctness law binds throughout (never conflate, full account numbers). GROUND TRUTH AT OUTSET (run org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/ADVI_49FSRC_ATOMDECOMP/run_20260824.md, R1-R16, committed @dd7a54a3a9): the two Schwab masters are ONE BOOK -- on fact_acc 2026-08-21, 7,238 of 7,336 (0833) / 7,258 (0824) accounts are shared and their dim_balance figures are CENT-IDENTICAL on every shared account (7,238/7,238 at the frontier; 3,930/3,930 at 2024-07-08) -- they differ by MEMBERSHIP only (98 accounts / $56.4M only-0833; 20 / $0.29M only-0824). So 'blend' is the measured shape, not a design choice: a UNION keyed on account_id x date, 0833 authoritative where both carry the account, 0824 supplying the pre-2024-07-08 tail and its exclusives, NEVER summed (NEVER-SUM and NEVER-SUBSTITUTE both stand, @b7dd2a231). The Schwab plane's best valuation floor is 2024-01-12 (0824 bronze positions/balances; ~92 days sit un-converted to silver, 0824 silver starts 2024-05-24; 0833 starts 2024-07-08); accounts/transactions reach 2024-01-16; realized lots 2023-01-17. It CANNOT reach the legacy served series' 2020-01-02 floor, which is Black-Diamond-derived (data/black_diamond/scripts/gold/D_00b.portal_timeseries.py reads ACCOUNT_PERFORMANCE). The BD dependency therefore has TWO halves taking DIFFERENT remedies (Rule 24 iv): (i) HISTORY 2020-01..2024-01 -- a one-time frozen import (closed-period-immutable, Rule 25 kind) or an accepted floor, never a standing feed -- SOVEREIGN FORK carded to Andrew; (ii) the three IDENTITY/ROLE join dims (blackdiamond/49f/silver/dim_advisor_fee_role, dim_account_xref, fact_bd_allocation) -- light tables the runner framework already reads as JOIN DIMS (JD1/JD2 pattern), to be hosted by 49F direct per his 08-21 strategic frame ('these custom dim tables ... are going to need to be hosted by them direct'). Geography is NOT a sourcing gap (fact_acc.ac_st 100% populated, 48 distinct, same state set on both masters); office (285 branch codes vs 9 offices) and the leaderboard -20 are traces, not sources. The D3 exact-join spec (SmartX<->BD/Schwab) folds into this PRD as a section -- the account_id join measured here IS the Schwab-plane half of it.
